m3-pytest-not-yet-written.title: Blocker 0: a stated not_yet_written declaration on the pytest kind, undecidable-not-fault, non-blocking, silence keeps strict default
m3-pytest-not-yet-written.imperative: TDD red->green. RED: write TestPytestNotYetWritten in tests/test_generate_spine.py covering: (a) declared not_yet_written + selector collects below min_collect -> Undecidable (not Fault), non-blocking (main() still writes the spine, exit 0); (b) declared + malformed selector (pytest usage error) -> still a Fault (well-formedness stays checked); (c) declared + a named target file that does not exist -> Undecidable, non-blocking, not a Fault; (d) silence (no declaration) + short collect -> unchanged strict Fault (regression pin); (e) the compiled statement carries a rendered marker so a reviewer sees the declaration on the gate, mirroring qualitative's '-- QUALITATIVE:' append; (f) end-to-end through main() on a real TOML spec: a not_yet_written pytest postcondition on an otherwise-valid gate makes main() exit 0 and write the spine -- this is the actual proof the generator can now author a TDD-shaped plan. Observe it fail. Attest c1. GREEN: add the not_yet_written field to the pytest kind. _probe_pytest returns a non-blocking Undecidable for the declared+short-collect and declared+missing-target cases (add a `blocking` field to the Undecidable dataclass, default True; declared-not-yet-written instances set it False); a malformed selector still refuses via a new probe-pytest-malformed-selector Fault regardless of the declaration. main()/probe_spec only refuse on blocking undecidables. compile_condition appends the rendered marker when not_yet_written is set. The compiled command itself (the runtime check the engine executes at gate close) is UNCHANGED -- strict enforcement still happens then, just not at generation time.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: TestPytestNotYetWritten written and observed failing -- manual attest
TestPytestNotYetWritten collects and passes: declared-not-yet-written no longer blocks generation, silence keeps the strict default, malformed selectors still refuse either way

Drove a real survey spine (claim/start/record/consolidate) via the CLI: consolidate reached verdict=APPROVE with no review-result ever attached to the large-claim item.
